EFullSourceTail.both_tests_full_source_nuclearNorm_finite_certificate.{w, u_1} (K : Type w) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  {κ : Type w} {ι : Type u_1} (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (M : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
  (u v : κ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (hcost : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖)
  (hfactor :
    ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun j => ⟪u j, F⟫_ℂ • v j)
        ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯) (M F)))
  (e : ι → ↥(JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)ᗮ) (J : Finset ι)
  (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (F : Finset κ) :
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let W := JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have E := (Q.FullSourceCutoff.fullFiniteSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s T).starProjection;
  have C := (ESourceResidual.finiteComplementSpan W e J).starProjection;
  have P := 1 - W.starProjection;
  Masullo.NuclearFactorization.nuclearNorm ((P.comp A).comp M - ((1 - E).comp A).comp M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j ∈ F, ‖u j‖ * ‖v j - E (v j) - C (v j)‖ + ∑' (j : { j // j ∉ F }), ‖u ↑j‖ * ‖v ↑j‖)
